references.context: Destroy the first two castles. Shoot the Castle front door to lower the drawbridge, hit the gate until it opens, then enter once.
references.label: Castle front door
references.description: The drawbridge and gate are in the center of the upper playfield.

references.context: If the Castle lock is repeatable, shoot it three times to start Castle Multiball.
references.label: Castle lock lane
references.description: The narrow lock lane jumps the moat just left of the castle entrance.

references.context: Madness qualification: Make 3 Catapult shots for Catapult Madness, 3 total orbit shots for Joust Madness, 4 left-ramp shots for Peasant Madness, and 4 right-ramp shots for Damsel Madness.
references.label: Catapult lane
references.description: The Catapult lane is the far-left major shot.

references.context: Let rebounds qualify Trolls. Do not force the yellow Troll standups when their return is unsafe.
references.label: Troll standup targets
references.description: The two yellow targets flank the center entrance below the castle.

references.context: When several Madness features are lit, shoot Merlin's saucer to start Multiball Madness. If Trolls! is also ready, start it with the multiball when the saucer offers both.
references.label: Merlin's Magic saucer
references.description: The mode-start saucer is immediately right of the castle entrance.

references.label: Peasant ramp
references.description: Four left-ramp shots qualify Peasant Madness and the ramp scores Castle Multiball Jackpots.
references.context: Make four left-ramp shots for Peasant Madness.

references.label: Damsel ramp
references.description: Four right-ramp shots qualify Damsel Madness; the fourth feeds the pop bumpers.
references.context: Make four right-ramp shots for Damsel Madness.

references.label: Joust orbits
references.description: Three total orbit shots qualify Joust Madness and later score wizard and multiball awards.
references.context: Make three total orbit shots for Joust Madness.
